verdict.line: You lose short trades into a fully recharged Granite Shield; you win extended fights where Last Rites sustain and Dark Procession walls take over.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Granite Shield only blunts the first hit of an exchange, while Yorick's Q (Last Rites) heals on every short cooldown and his W (Dark Procession) can trap Malphite mid-trade. The matchup rewards drawn-out skirmishes over all-ins, which lines up with the measured 51% win rate across 1020 games and Yorick's stated lane and solo-kill advantage.

theirWindow.what: His first hit in the trade is absorbed by the shield, so an all-in here trades worse than it looks. Poke it down with E (Mourning Mist) first instead of walking into a fresh shield.

yourWindow.when: His Q and E both down
yourWindow.what: With Seismic Shard (8s CD) and Ground Slam (7s CD) both on cooldown he has no speed-steal to catch a retreat and no shockwave to wipe your Mist Walkers. Commit your full trade and summon your passive here.

powerCurve.note: Granite Shield blunts your first pokes
Q sustain and W walls win extended trades
Maiden widens the damage gap in skirmishes
Brutal Strikes burst and Unstoppable Force threaten picks

start.why: The flat damage reduction on his autos and Ground Slam pokes is what 57.2% of Yorick players take into this matchup, and it's the better pick of the two listed starts for soaking early trades.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the airtime on Unstoppable Force knock-ups and the magic resist blunts Ground Slam, and it's the higher-win-rate boots choice at 54% over 655 games.

core.why: Empowered-auto damage and move speed let you stick through Granite Shield's recharge window and punish his lack of a dash.
The armor shred stacks through his Brutal Strikes armor buff, keeping your sustained-trade damage relevant into the mid game.
Ability haste lowers your Q and E cooldowns further, which is the whole axis you're winning this lane on.

situational.when: if he's landing clean Ground Slam and Unstoppable Force combos on you
if you need the slow to stop him walking out of Dark Procession
if you're ahead and splitting rather than fighting him directly

runes.keystoneWhy: Every proc tops off your health in exactly the kind of grinding, shield-recharge-denying trades this lane is built around, and this page is the more-picked of the two at 27.9%.

summoners.why: This pairing posts the highest measured win rate of the three listed (51.5%) and matches the stated solo-kill advantage — Ignite closes out the extended trades this matchup is won on.

playing.title: Poke only when his E is down
playing.detail: Throw Mourning Mist while Ground Slam (7s CD) is on cooldown so your summoned Mist Walkers survive to apply its move speed bonus instead of getting wiped by his shockwave.

playing.title: Don't all-in a full shield
playing.detail: Granite Shield recharges when he hasn't been hit recently. Hit him with E first to start the shield decaying before you commit your Q auto.

playing.title: Wall him in with W
playing.detail: Dark Procession blocks enemy movement — drop it to cut off his retreat mid-trade or to seal him away from minions he needs for Brutal Strikes stacking damage.

playing.title: Respect Seismic Shard in exchanges
playing.detail: His Q (8s CD, 625 range) steals your move speed on hit, so don't throw your E from max range and then stand still waiting for his follow-up.

playing.title: Spend Q on cooldown, not on cooldown-watch
playing.detail: Last Rites drops to a 4s cooldown at max rank — use it on lane minions between trades to keep your sustain topped up rather than holding it only for champion hits.

playing.title: Hold R for a committed fight
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles is 160 seconds at rank 1, so summon the Maiden when you're ready to actually fight through a trade, not defensively to scare him off.

playing.title: Play wide after level 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has 1000 range and knocks up on arrival — don't stand in a straight line with low-health allies once he hits 6.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (Q) while using [E] to poke. However, his (E) can get rid of [P] easily so try to use it when (E) is on cooldown.
